scope: UltraBERT seven-role human annotation trials. All training/evaluation pilot figures below use case-disjoint splits of official train. Original source test untouched.
metric: unweighted mean of seven pooled-sentence class F1s; absent class gets a zero. Accuracy is a separate pooled proportion.

splits.pilot: fit/edit use source-label-balanced anchor snippets from separate cases; selection and confirmation use label-blind whole cases limited to 20–65 nonblank sentences. The second sample nests the initial pilot.
splits.shared_validation: 16 frozen official val judgments; every nonblank sentence. Independent train-split-only candidate selection.

inputs: Native FP32 encoder; contiguous text, per-row membership and newline separators, 384 text tokens per block; long rows use multiple blocks.
incumbent_on_pilot_reason: The pilot deliberately uses official training cases. The prior Attoflow release incorporates a published donor trained on this split; no prospective top-line comparison belongs here.

runs.method: native pretrained MLM head nonlinear projection with seven fixed vocabulary output coordinates
native pretrained MLM head nonlinear projection with seven fixed vocabulary output coordinates
original input table legal token-count assignment, text; direct embedding pooling skips the contextual encoder
original input table legal token-count assignment, structure; direct embedding pooling skips the contextual encoder

lexical_common16_exact_spans.definition: Within each judgment, combine consecutive original CSV sentences bearing one identical role. An exact labeled run requires both end boundaries plus the class to match. Boundary F1 scores class changes between sentences; literal character boundary detection is unmeasured.

portable_lexical_runtime.source: real FP32 original 49,152 × 768 input embeddings plus stored low-rank write, projected once into seven score directions
portable_lexical_runtime.timing_note: Measured during other same-host jobs; model loading excluded; tokenize and seven-state document decoding included.

previous_role_weight_edits.tensor: 8 materializations of ultrabert.embed_tokens.weight, one per previous role or START
